chunks: And with this chain of narration, it was said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said:

It seems that I have been called [to answer the call of death] and I have accepted it. And indeed, I am leaving among you two weighty things, one of which is greater than the other: The Book of Allah, a rope extended from the heaven to the earth; and my 'Itrat (offspring), my Ahl al-Bayt (Household). So see how you manage them in my absence.
ai.seo_question: What are the two weighty things left by the Prophet according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This tradition, recorded by Shaykh al-Saduq, highlights the inseparable bond between the Quran and the Ahl al-Bayt as the two enduring sources of guidance for the Shia community. By describing the Book as a 'rope extended from heaven to earth,' the Prophet underscores its divine stability, while elevating his 'Itrat to an equal or superior status, reflecting the Shia belief in their infallible role in interpreting the text. This dual legacy ensures that believers remain on the straight path after his departure.

en.dr-ali-peiravi: 31-40 According to the same documentation, God’s Prophet (S) said,

“It seems that I have been called in and I have accepted the call. I will depart you, but will leave two weighty things with you one of which is greater than the other one. It is God’s Book that is a rope extended out from the heavens onto the Earth. The other one is my ‘Itrat; that is members of my Household. Therefore watch and see how you treat these two after me.”
